notes: Checked by scripts/check-budget.mjs after every npm run build. The gates and targets are DURABLE-11's (QA_DURABLE.md): boot JS and render-blocking CSS gzipped at level 9 (KB = 1000 bytes), any chunk loaded on demand, and the service worker's precache. lazyOnly is STUDENT-15's: these modules must never be in a boot file (scripts/vite-plugin-budget.mjs writes the module map it is read from). The last three are curriculum stage 4's (GEOM-2 to GEOM-4): the transform and proof objects, which register with content/manip.js when the lesson loads them, and the transformations unit's generators, which load with its teaching (content/lazyGen.js). The student lane's own deltas over 5618298 (+6 KB JS, +0 KB CSS) measured its share on its branch; on the integrated app the gates above hold the whole first load, as that lane's notes said they would.
